title: Active filter shows completed tasks instead of tasks that are still pending
body:
The task list screen has three filter chips: All, Active, and Completed. Selecting Active is supposed to show only tasks that have not been finished yet, but it instead shows tasks that have already been checked off.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch the app with the seeded mix of completed and pending tasks.
2. Note which tasks are checked and unchecked under All.
3. Tap the Active filter.

Expected behavior:
Only tasks that are not completed should appear.

Actual behavior:
The Active list shows completed tasks, while pending tasks disappear.

Additional context:
The All filter works correctly and the Completed filter also works correctly. The issue is specifically with the Active filter logic.
